I can help with that. Let me pull up your program and this week's schedule first. I can't see an active program on your account right now, so I don't know which sessions are left this week. Once one is running, tell me which days you can actually train and I'll work out how to fit the important work into three.

If you want me to build a 3-day version, I can do that too. Tell me what you want from it, like the lifts you care most about and whether it's strength or general fitness, and I'll set it up for you.
